item.title: Lionesses defeat Newhaven at home
item.description: Millwall Lionesses recorded their fourth straight win on Sunday as they defeated Newhaven 3-1 at St Paul's. Toni-Anne Bussey, Ciara Watling and Maisie Joyce were on target as Ted Jones' side moved up to sixth place in the London & South East Regional Women's Premier League table. Next up for Millwall Lionesses is a trip to Dartford on Sunday 22nd February Millwall: Gmiterek, Butler, Joyce, Buddle-Smith, Watling, Squirrell, Coldrick, Bussey, Seely, Edwards, Winfield. Subs: Jones, Bailey, Townsend

item.title: MCT release 2025 Annual Report
item.description: Millwall Community Trust has released its 2025 Annual Report. The report covers the work and the impact the Trust has had on the local community in the past year.CLICK HERE TO READA word from Millwall Community Trust Chairman Keith Soper: 2025 has once again been a year of sustained progress for the trust. We live in very challenging times with ever increasing numbers of people struggling with the effects of the increasing cost of living and the associated stark increase in mental health issues.

item.title: Millwall quartet visit Premier League Kicks tournament
item.description: Millwall FC First-Team duo Macaulay Langstaff and Josh Coburn alongside Millwall Lionesses’ Olivia Coldrick and Sharna Giordani visited Millwall Community Trust’s Premier League Kicks Tournament at St Paul’s Sports Ground. The tournament consisted of six girls teams and seven boys teams with 130 participants taking part. item.title: Joe Bryan and Casper De Norre visit MCT’s Half-Term Holiday Camps
item.description: Millwall FC First-Team duo Casper De Norre and Joe Bryan visited Millwall Community Trust’s (MCT) February Half-Term Holiday Camps at The Lions Centre. MCT runs in excess of 100 football and multisport courses across 13 weeks of the year in the London Boroughs of Lewisham and Southwark and across Kent. item.title: Kendall at the double as Under 21s beat Bristol City
item.description: Kevin Nugent’s men recorded a 2-1 home victory over Bristol City on Tuesday afternoon, in a match which featured numerous senior players for Millwall's Under 21s. Sheldon Kendall's two goals - one in either half - saw the three Professional Development League points remain at Calmont Road. item.description: Under 21s Manager Kevin Nugent spoke to millwallfc.co.uk after the 2-1 Professional Development League triumph over Bristol City on Tuesday afternoon. item.title: Under 18s beaten at Colchester
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s were beaten 4-2 by Colchester United in the Professional Development League on Tuesday afternoon. Goals from a Trialist and Ndige kept The Lions competitive in Essex, but they were to suffer defeat at Florence Park. The reverse League fixture takes place this Saturday, as The Lions host The U's at Calmont Road.FixturesColchester United U18 Vs. Millwall U18 - Tue, Feb 17 2026, 13:00

item.description: Back-to-back away wins! The Lions defeated Sheffield Wednesday 2-1 at Hillsborough on Saturday afternoon, with an own-goal accompanied by Macaulay Langstaff's winner in S6. Below, take a look at the latest edition of 'Fly On The Wall'!
